## Describe the Bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include any error messages verbatim.

## Screenshots / Logs

If applicable, add screenshots or console logs. You can open DevTools in the desktop app with `F12`.

## Environment

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| OS | e.g. Windows 11 22H2 |
| BridgeCam Version | e.g. 0.1.0 |
| Phone OS | e.g. iOS 17 / Android 14 |
| Phone Browser | e.g. Safari / Chrome Android |
| Desktop Browser (for host.html) | e.g. Chrome 120 |

## Additional Context

Any other context about the problem (e.g. only happens on first launch, only on certain networks, etc.).
